text.title: Shattered Beacons
text.body: Three towering runic beacons project an interlocking barrier of violet lightning across the valley floor. Armed with Ward-Scholar Elowen's and Chronicler Zahra's harmonic calculations from Acts II and III, Marshal Vance orders a tripartite strike against the West, Center, and East beacon garrisons.
text.msg.1: Chronicler Zahra's Redmarsh harmonics and Elowen's Oakhaven notes pinpointed the fault lines in this violet grid. Shatter all three beacon garrisons and bring the Iron Pact's outer shield crashing down!
text.msg.2: The West Beacon collapses into smoking glass—the center pylon fractures into blinding arcs!
text.msg.3: The Center Beacon shatters in a burst of violet static!
text.msg.4: The East Beacon topples! The blinding glare snaps out—look ahead, the silhouette of the Infernal Citadel!
text.msg.5: Two beacons are down—the Iron Pact hurls its valley floor reserves into a desperate counter-surge!
text.win: All three runic pylons lie in smoking glass and the Infernal Citadel looms ahead.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell beneath the shattered beacons.
